helperConstants.name: TextLabel wrap/anchor width
helperConstants.note: SetArea(l=r.right,t=r.top,r=1000,b=r.bottom). SHARED by all 86 TextLabel sites - align-6 labels position at x-windowWidth, so a blind change shifts every right-aligned column. Scope per call site (detour) or not at all. (BUDGET-DETAIL-ANATOMY §POPUP Q2)

helperConstants.name: Combo width
helperConstants.note: lea edi,[edx+0x78]. disp8 CEILING 127 -> 2x (240) CANNOT be encoded in place; shipped as a runtime width pin in UiSpike.

helperConstants.name: Combo height
helperConstants.note: lea edx,[ecx+0xf]. Same disp8 limit; 2x (30) DOES fit.

helperConstants.name: Slider height
helperConstants.note: lea edx,[ecx+0xe]. Shared by all 4 Slider sites; 2x (28) fits. NOT currently patched by CodePatches.cpp.
